scientific_limitations: The theorem treats unit-long-side, fixed-angle nondegenerate Euclidean parallelograms as the short side tends to zero. The error constant is angle-dependent; no arbitrary-convex-body extension, joint small-angle bound, or optimal next remainder is proved. The original planar inequality and classical interior line-picking formulas are not claimed as new.
title: Universal linear and angular logarithmic saturation for thin parallelograms
